methodology.run_statistics: Arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) across independent benchmark runs.
methodology.request_percentiles: Computed after pooling request-level values from all runs (32 requests per complete configuration), using NumPy linear interpolation.
methodology.tpot_definition: 1000 * (end-to-end latency - TTFT) / (output tokens - 1), in milliseconds per request.
methodology.itl_definition: Intervals between recorded streaming output events/chunks; a speculative-decoding chunk may contain multiple tokens, so ITL is not a complete per-token arrival distribution.
methodology.paired_speedup: For each seed, candidate output throughput / normal output throughput; report mean and sample stdev of the run-level ratios. Ratio of mean throughputs is also provided.
methodology.confidence_intervals: Not computed; three-run sample stdev is not a confidence interval.
methodology.cross_gpu_caveat: Formal round 1 runs methods concurrently on separate B200 GPUs. Final interpretation requires same-GPU checks and rotation.
methodology.best_fixed_selection: When requested, the best fixed method is selected using the same three runs used for descriptive paired comparisons; this is a post-selection comparison, not an independent generalization estimate.
